name: guard-hpcc-homa-general-formal
purpose: Five-seed matched-flow comparison of optimized GUARD, HPCC, and the qualified Homa ns-3 implementation.
selection_policy: Freeze all traces before simulation. Admit each workload using seed 1 mechanism counters without inspecting performance. Expand seeds 2-5 only after all three arms pass. Protocol-native scheduling is enabled: GUARD uses its frozen size priorities and bounded sender SRPT; Homa uses its workload-derived priorities, sender SRPT, and receiver overcommit.

admission.guard: grants and valid HPCC feedback/rate changes/reactive binding are all nonzero; sender SRPT selections and non-RR choices are nonzero
admission.hpcc: GUARD grants are zero and valid HPCC feedback/rate changes are nonzero
admission.homa: DATA, grants, tracked/completed messages, completion notices, max pending state, and at least two DATA priorities are nonzero; generic RDMA recovery is zero
